candidateChanges.summary: Installed-tarball exercise exposed --help exit 64; added standard --help/-h success handling and regression test.
Changed package private flag to false so a later separately approved npm publication is technically possible.
Added a package files allowlist so evidence commits do not alter the distributed tarball.

limitations: This evidence proves only the exact artifact-build commit tarball was built, installed, and observed under the recorded fixture, Node runtime, policy, vocabulary, and required command.
The release-evidence commit is deliberately excluded from the package files allowlist; a clean final-candidate pack must match this artifact digest before any later publish decision.
No npm publication, tag, GitHub release, rule expansion, policy-semantics change, or automatic rewriting occurred in this preparation slice.
